features: Long MOT badge with at least nine full calendar months remaining, from fresh DVSA records and latest passed test only
Official first MOT due date for new vehicles; never inferred from model year or registration band
Two compact controls directly below the price, above the gallery on phones
Road-mile delivery calculator uses existing dealership settings; quote retained when reopening
Cache-only MOT read on arrival; full provider lookup only on user action; no polling
coverage: Auto Trader and Cazoo public dealership fixtures
WebKit: 320px small phone, iPhone 13, iPad Pro 11 and 1440px desktop
Existing MOT and unsaved invoice part-exchange checks: Luxxy, Shore Drive and Multi-Choice on iPhone and iPad
Latest failure suppresses badge; missing registration, unavailable history, first due date, delivery disabled, retained quote, keyboard focus and mobile title/close-button overlap
protections: No changes to invoices, stock, customer records or payments
No database migration, credential or schedule changes
limits: Device profiles are browser simulations, not physical-device testing
Provider replies and delivery quotes use isolated fixtures; current live provider availability is not retested
External car-photo requests were deliberately blocked in browser tests; photo fallback in screenshots is expected
Cars with no fresh cached MOT data show the history button without a badge until checked
